evidence.why: Conditional ammunition decrement and unconditional constructor call.
Owner, facing, zero velocity and distinct position fields.
Guarded creation and ordered initialization.

facts.rationale: Preserves the established construction flow while correcting the unconditional-ammunition implication and distinguishing the two spawn position fields.
facts.value: The L-Gun firing routine passes its owner, requested position and facing; it decrements ammunition only when positive but calls this constructor unconditionally. The position helper copies the requested position to spawn.prev_pos with Z forced to zero and separately fills spawn.pos through it_8026BB68(owner_gobj, ...). Spawn fields retain the owner and facing and start velocity at zero. If item creation succeeds, the initializer applies article lifetime and state 0, then the constructor sets ray scale to zero, angle to 0 only when facing equals +1 and otherwise pi, stored speed from the article, ray position from spawn.pos, and X velocity to speed times facing before debug setup. Creation failure skips all created-item initialization.

The owner supplies spawn ownership and the owner-position helper input; pos supplies spawn.prev_pos with Z flattened to zero, not the separate spawn.pos copied into the ray snapshot. evidence.why: Construction, snapshot, collision and interaction bodies.
Shared velocity/animation, reflection, shield rebound and spawn helpers.
Conditional reference cleanup delegated by EvtUnk.

facts.rationale: Replaces the overbroad claim that combat callbacks consume the position snapshot with the actual distinct data paths, including cross-file trajectory and reference-lifetime responsibilities.
facts.value: Owner, requested position and facing enter a fallible spawn request; the position helper keeps flattened requested prev_pos separate from owner-derived spawn.pos. Successful creation initializes article lifetime and speed, zero scale, facing-derived angle and X velocity, and a snapshot of spawn.pos. The shared animation updater recomputes XY velocity from stored speed/angle and updates model orientation and scale; physics refreshes the position snapshot. Collision forwards the embedded collision record. Damage, clank, shield hit and absorption ignore the object and return true; reflection updates facing/speed and resets ray scale/angle, shield bounce mirrors velocity through the shared helper, and EvtUnk delegates matching-object reference cleanup.
